reason: Research (web search, 2026-11-21) shows the week's drawdown was an AI-led liquidation: chip and hyperscaler stocks sold off on doubts about AI profits, Nvidia's guidance midpoint came in below consensus, the Dow fell 1,100 points on 11-19, and Treasury yields eased as money went to safety. That is the concentration unwind this book is built around, not a break in its thesis. Every leg fell 5-6.4% in a tape where SPY fell about 8.6%, so the equal-weight, cash-flow value, industrial, regional-bank, healthcare and energy legs lost less than the index, as designed. All stops are still 4.6-8.6 points away, and the 34% cash buffer earns 4% and leaves room to add later. Re-entering the whole book would cost basis points and reset the stops to a lower base for no change in exposure. I also see no reason to add risk into a five-day decline before the tape stabilises. Hold as registered. Caveat: I could not find a same-day wrap for the 11-20 session itself.
